items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Kenny say, well, whatever he's doing down there, he's down there, so let him alone. Kenny's at the Blue Note...

ctx.x: Kenny Clarke, they was down losing their minds down there, and Teddy Hill was running it

down there and at that time, I was on the Hill. See, I am with the aristocrats. I'd met Willie Lewis and them, they had been in Harlem there and then they went to Portugal and got, something happened, they got to fighting, of all places, fighting in Portugal and there's no where to go and they gone get to fighting and they working that beautiful casino and they the bass player is fighting with the trumpet player.
